summary.text: Brian Kavanagh is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 27 in Lower Manhattan and chairs the Housing, Construction and Community Development Committee.
Ballotpedia reports that on February 3, 2026, he announced he would not run for re-election in 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to Wikipedia, Kavanagh graduated from Regis High School and from Princeton University in 1989 with a degree in politics, and received a Juris Doctor from New York University School of Law.
He was an aide to New York City mayors Ed Koch and David Dinkins and chief of staff to Council Member Gale Brewer, and was the first policy director of the city's Department of Homeless Services.
After an unsuccessful bid for the City Council in 2005, Wikipedia says he was elected to the State Assembly in November 2006.
He won a 2017 special election to succeed state Senator Daniel Squadron and was elected to a full term in 2018.

Wikipedia says that when Democrats took the Senate majority in 2019 he became chair of the Housing, Construction and Community Development Committee, and that he has served on the Environmental Conservation Committee throughout his legislative career.
